record.author: handoff-research (owner-managed session); scenario participants are fictional

budget.basis: scenario design limit, not a measured account balance
budget.stop_when: one pass ends, or evidence/permission is missing

permissions.authority: synthetic scenario scope only; does not grant any real authorization
allowed: Read the supplied local text fixtures and draft a qualified finding.
requires_new_authorization: Spend money, request credentials, or publish a claim.
Change the task scope or acceptance condition.

goal: Verify the completed-case count for S-18 against a primary record.
acceptance: Accessible primary evidence fixes the count and dataset version.

attempts.step: Scenario sender recorded that the fictional primary source could not be obtained.
attempts.outcome: No primary bytes were obtained; the scenario supplies only a secondary-note fixture. No real network request was performed.

blocker.condition: Primary source and dataset version are absent.
blocker.unblocks_when: A lawfully accessible primary record with a verifiable version is supplied, or the authorized task owner explicitly revises acceptance.

sources.provenance: Locally authored synthetic scenario note; fictional secondary statement, not primary evidence.
sources.limits: Contains no primary extract or reproducible dataset version.

sources.locator: fictional source S-18; no real URL supplied
sources.limits: No inspected contents; cannot support any count.

claims.text: The scenario note attributes a count of 12 to an unversioned secondary statement.

resume.next_action: Verify and inspect the supplied note; record that primary evidence is missing and prepare an unsent request specifying the needed record and version.
stop_conditions: Do not infer primary contents from the note or a title.
Stop before access restrictions, payment, credentials, contact, or publication.
still_unresolved: Whether primary evidence can be obtained.
Whether revised acceptance would still answer the original question.
